name: Lean-STaR
one_liner: Bootstraps interleaved informal thoughts and formal Lean tactics via expert iteration and best-first proof search verified by the Lean kernel.

loop.proposes: A language model generates a rationale thought followed by a formal Lean tactic at each node of the proof tree.
loop.judged_by: The Lean proof assistant checks whether the tactic advances or closes the goal.
loop.steers: Best-first tree search explores multiple thought-tactic branches, and verified trajectories are used to fine-tune the model in STaR expert-iteration rounds.

headline_result: Improved miniF2F-test pass@64 in Lean from 30.8% to 46.3%, outperforming tactic-only search baselines.
caveat: Generating natural-language thoughts before every tactic increases token count per node during tree search.
beyond_harness_note: Best-first proof search and Lean kernel verification filter thought-augmented tactic trajectories to retrain the generator.
algorithmic_authority: Lean theorem prover and best-first search tree

sources.title: Lean-STaR: Learning to Interleave Thinking and Proving (ICLR 2025 / arXiv:2407.10040)

verification.notes: Checked against Lin et al., arXiv:2407.10040.
